chunks.subject: science
chunks.text: Living Things and Environment (Year 6) Food Chain: A food chain shows how food moves from one living thing to another. Plants are producers. Animals are consumers. Competition: Living things compete for food, water, space and mates. Relationships: Parasitism means one organism benefits and the other is harmed. Adaptation: Plants have special features like small leaves and deep roots to survive. Investigation: Manipulated variable is what we change. Responding variable is what we observe.
